verdict.rationale: Graphite lets you write custom rules, explicit guidelines that Graphite Agent follows when reviewing code (graphite-docs-5), and the agent automatically reviews every new PR in the selected repos (graphite-docs-19, graphite-docs-4). That covers custom AI review criteria applied on every PR. However, the evidence frames these as review comments and guidelines, not as pass/fail pre-merge checks that gate merging, and it never confirms that rules are written in free-form plain language. missing for 10: evidence that custom rules act as pre-merge status checks that block or gate merges, explicit confirmation that rules are written in plain language (e.g. 'docs updated', 'tests cover new paths'), worked examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
